node.statement: Proposition 2.1 (SoS partial trace): Let D = dr. If M_{A1 B1 A2 B2} lies in SoS(D) (the cone of sums of Hermitian squares on C^D tensor C^D), then tr_{B1 B2}(M) lies in SoS(d). Proof: If M = sum_i c_i (X_i tensor X_i) with X_i Hermitian on C^D and c_i >= 0, then tr_{B1 B2}(M) = sum_i c_i (tr_B(X_i) tensor tr_B(X_i)). Since tr_B(X_i) is Hermitian on C^d, each term is in SoS(d), so the sum is in SoS(d).
